build_CITADELRetrievalTask: build a CITADELRetrievalTask instance with checkpoint path, context embeddings directory, and IVF index configuration
run_CITADELRetrievalTask_setup: run the setup method to load checkpoint state dict, passages dataset, and initialize GPU or CPU IVF index
test_CITADELRetrievalTask_eval_step: test the _eval_step method to encode queries, aggregate expert embeddings, and search the index for top-k results
review_CITADELRetrievalTask_merge_trec_r: review the merge_trec_results method that formats retrieval results into TREC evaluation format with topic IDs and scores
summarize_CITADELRetrievalTask_merge_qa_: summarize the merge_qa_results method that combines questions, answers, and retrieved document contexts into QA result JSON
